CreepJoinerBenefitDef.label: flesh retainer
CreepJoinerBenefitDef.letterExtra: {PAWN_nameDef} possesses a weakened version of Hela's power, known as flesh retainer. Parasitism does not increase {PAWN_possessive} body factor, and {PAWN_pronoun} is not a node creature. {PAWN_pronoun} has 4 parasite capacity and begins with one random small fleshbeast. Consuming a shard increases parasite capacity, up to 10, and causes a one-day coma.
